Drafters for Qwen3.8-27B and Meta's Muse Glimmer are out today. Has anyone tried Qwen 3.8 27B with DFlash2 on a DGX Spark yet?

sources.snippet: The block-diffusion drafter from z-lab/Inco AI (z-lab/Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2, mirror of incoai/…) is a separate 2B draft model (~4 GB) that drafts entire token blocks in parallel; a lightweight selector picks the coherent path, the target model verifies - output provably identical (rejection sampling).
